topic: Sheep people are darling, sweet and draining. Five warm ways to love one, and a weekend challenge to do one of them.
phrases: Give a push, not a shove.
They don't need you for this. They want you anyway.

images.concept: The shoulder to lean on, seen from behind in warm autumn light.
images.prompt: A cinematic film still of two people seen from behind sitting close on a weathered wooden park bench in soft autumn light, a woman in a dusty rose coat resting her head on the other person's shoulder. Faces not visible. Antique gold light through turning leaves, a path fading into soft focus. Tender and unhurried. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A match being struck beside an unlit lantern: lighting someone else's fire.
images.prompt: A cinematic close-up of a single match just catching flame, held near the wick of an old brass lantern on a wooden table. Hands at the edge of the frame only, no face. Antique gold glow against midnight jade shadow. Warm and hopeful. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.
